title: Rep. Keith Self addresses Sharia law, COVID-19 policies, and nonprofit funding in March 2026 posts
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a member of the U.S. House of Representatives, published a series of posts on March 30, 2026, addressing topics ranging from religious governance to pandemic policies and nonprofit funding.
In a post made at 13:45 UTC, Self commented on the nature of Sharia law: “Sharia is far more than a personal faith—it’s a culture of governance and domination that pushes submission through violence. We must never accommodate a system that demands the submission of every surrounding society.”
Later that day at 15:01 UTC, Self reflected on governmental actions during the COVID-19 pandemic: “No Kings! But during COVID… Americans were forced to take a vaccine and punished if they didn’t. Schools were shut down, hindering developmental learning for an entire generation. Big corporations were propped up during the pandemic while local businesses struggled to”
At 15:34 UTC, Self announced new legislative action targeting foreign influence in American nonprofits: “I just introduced the GUARD Act to stop foreign adversaries from funneling money into American nonprofits. If you take money from hostile regimes, you should not receive tax-exempt status subsidized by American taxpayers. Period.”
Keith Self has secured his seat in Congress through consecutive victories over Sandeep Srivastava in both the 2022 and 2024 general elections, winning with significant margins each time.
